pages.text: [#](53341a)A rite is the intentional manipulation of the world through circle, ingredient, and power. The circle gives structure; the ingredient names the working; the altar provides fuel.[#]()
pages.title: Rites of Power

pages.text: [#](53341a)Some rites also need creatures present — part of the mechanism, not ceremony.[#]() [#](53341a)Experimentation is encouraged. The craft does not document all of its own workings.[#]()

[#](53341a)**Infusion** (small) grants a lasting magical nature. **Charging** (small+medium, Attuned Stone) uses glowstone, redstone, wood ash, and quicklime. **Familiar Binding** (small) binds a tamed animal. **Forest** (large, any sapling) grows a grove.[#]()
pages.title: A Selection

pages.text: [#](53341a)**Waystone Binding** and **Transposition** anchor and move you.[#]()
